steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hey? M... Madam Dagda?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You still want us to keep calling you that, right...? I'm here to apologize for the scrap yesterday. Hannah's too embarrassed to come herself, but she did help pick out these clothes and all.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Um, that whole malarkey yesterday, that's just how the Glasgow Gang does nice-to-meet-yous. If we're not all in agreement, then we let fists do the talking first. I've not got anything against you in actuality, love!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: So, want to give these clothes a peep?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm sorry, Madam Morgan, but I don't think I should be here or be party to these. It's not in accordance with etiquette.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The principal source of any friction with me was Madam Indra. There's no need for any apologies from you.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: And these clothes are hardly suitable given my current standing and circumstances. I won't be wearing them, and I won't be forsaking my rescue of Her Royal Highness.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Wait, pause it with the 'etiquette' and the 'standing' and whatever. You're just going to turn these down, out of hand?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Madam Morgan, I really apologize, but I shouldn't...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: One sec!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Look, we're giving you this to say sorry! It's a whole outfit, all brand-new! The least you could do is look first before you decide!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: This... I...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Ahem! Madam Morgan... it's the duty of we Knights of the Tower that we support Her Royal Highness in Her accession to the throne. My mentor has consistently impressed the matter of the vacant throne on me, that it rests barren.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It's a mission and a responsibility I take incredibly seriously, and I'm very thankful for your help these past few days, but...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oh, stuff this and stuff you and STUFF YER MOUTH! You like it, I can tell! So put it ON!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Guh!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It's not right for a Knight of the Tower to—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Wait, just one moment...!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: —Well!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Ha-ha-HA! Now that looks bang-up on you.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Well, thank you. Now that I've tried on your gift, I think I should change back into my original clothing.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Let me root around... Got a trimmer here! I can do up your eyebrows one sec.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Wait, I don't—

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Stop blinking! I'm just trimming your brows, love, calm down! I've got my studs here too, if you want me to pierce you up? I'm telling you, earrings would go smashing with this outfit!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Once we're all done here, you'll be a member of the Glasgow Gang just like us!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: FINE! If you hate it, then I'll bloody take it off for you!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina gave me half an earful yesterday and I'll admit she talked some real sense, but if you're dead set against us, then let's go for round two! Let our fists do the talking!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Eyy-up—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Flip's sakes, what now?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm keeping it on!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Thank you, Madam Morgan. I do love this outfit, and these earrings.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Also... could you help fix up my brows for me...? I'll try not to blink.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Wait, so you accept Indra's apology?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I knew it! You were never narked at us really!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah's just loud-mouthed and cocky in spades. If you went serious one-on-one, she'd never beat you.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: 'Scuse me?!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Dagda... Madam Dagda, that is, you might want to slow down too. You just arrived and all—Vina's still thinking it over herself.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: And I mean, Hannah too. You spouted all that 'protect the honor of Victoria' guff at her and you could see the dynamite go off inside her, but she doesn't hold it against you. She'd just rather kick any noble in the gonads, that's all.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Madam Morgan, I feel we can refrain from keeping our distance. You can simply call me Dagda.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: And Hannah? Can she call you that too?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: She... can, I... suppose.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Here, you can have these earrings now.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Looking good, right fit! You were made for this style! Shame Vina's not a patch on you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: She's dressed like the arse-end of Bottom Alley right now. How about sometime we give her a makeover like yours?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Ah... If it would be for Her Highness...!
Adhering by your counsel, I have found Her Royal Highness Alexandrina. However, it shocked me to find that she did not wish to leave her present companions, to travel with me.
Your teachings are still writ in my head. It was every one of you that broke the capture and delivered me out... (The text is struck through.)
(Fresh handwriting follows.)
Her Highness's present companions are a cohort of gang members, with Her as their leader.
Madams Indra and Morgan have given me new uniform, the latter of whom also gifted me her earrings. They say that from today forth, I may consider myself too a member of the Glasgow Gang.
I'm reminded of the time Master Bailey first taught me makeup, as well as her taking me to see the fashion show in secret. I had all but forgotten those memories.

Yet I have not forgotten the vacant throne I am entrusted with, being that I cannot let the Knights fall in further disgrace. I know I can never accomplish this alone no matter what, but this purpose has brought me to this day, and is what I exist for.
I will see our liege back, and Victoria's throne will be vacant no more.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bloody Morgan had me on! I just knew it, I could see her dying to laugh when she agreed! Stunk of evil, that!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I don't think I should be teaching a class right now, though. I wanted to prepare a little before we return, plus I never hang around the Training Room in the first place...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Gonna do Vina's work, then? Talk with the Doctor about heading back to Londinium?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What talks are they even having? We're heading back, full stop. As a Knight of the Tower, don't you think I should be elsewhere...?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Cork it! You're here, with me, so let's try these lot on for size! Now no more chatter!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: ...Indra?

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: (Jackie, is Instructor Indra always this testy?)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (I think some stuff happened in Victoria...)

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Gah! Whatever, you bloody lot don't know how long the story is. Here's the deal! We're going, so today's the last chance you get to fight us!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Our little girl here can explain the rest to you. I... am DONE talking now!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Ahem. Er... I'll be your opponent for today.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Right. You can call me Dagda.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm not too sure what you've been doing before, so we'll go through some daily exercises for today. I'd like all to follow along properly, if you'd please.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Now then... let's begin.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Based on my experiences being trained, you'll first want a grasp on your swimming, lancing and fencing skills, as well as learning how to wipe off your weapons, and fight in coordination.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Er, I'll demonstrate them to you one by one now... no, wait. You don't need to be studying this...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm imagining—you're here to learn how to engage in practical combat.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Indra, can you help me one second? I want us to demonstrate for them how I used to spar in training.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You're on!

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: This is your first training session, Isabelle Montague. Before you formally begin training as a Knight of the Tower, I want you to always keep this in mind—

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Victoria's throne will not be vacant forever.

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: Yes, Master!

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: ...My mother instructed me that we nobles should be the pride of Victoria.

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: But more than that pride, it's duty I hope to succeed. Though the Palace stands empty, the honor I protect is all the same! Disgrace will never fall on our name again!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Now watch and bloody learn!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Hngh—!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: (Abdomen, face, both exposed points...)

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: (I'll focus on them...)

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Isabelle Montague—

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Dark be the lights of the Palace. It falls to me, upon this hour, to anoint thee as a Knight of the Tower.

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: Yes, Master!

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: You have wiped clean your weapon. Do you swear here and now, that you will uphold the peace?

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: I swear.

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Do you swear here and now, that you will relinquish your personal greed, that you will inherit the spirit and honor of the Knights of the Tower, that you will pledge fealty to the Kingdom?

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: I swear.

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Do you swear here and now, that you will devote the remainder of your life to protecting Victoria, to protecting this nation?

steps.name: Isabella
steps.text: I swear!

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Your oath is made.

steps.name: Finn
steps.text: Isabelle Montague, no longer are you apprentice under the Tower. You are now a Knight of the Tower, in all trueness and formality.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Whoa! That one was crazy!

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: Wow, she almost sent Instructor Indra flying... Is Instructor Dagda just this powerful?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: (This won't do. Master Finn taught me that modesty was a knight's virtue...)

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: (I'm here to assist. Knocking Indra away is far from right.)

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: (And she'd buy a ceiling lamp and end with a bath heater if she just gets angry enough...)

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oi, oi, now I've got you wide open!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: My turn!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hahaha! How LONG'S it been since I went like this? This is the STUFF!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Give your hand here, I'll pull you up!

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: Wow... You can tell Instructor Indra's got real-deal talent, though! What a turnaround!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I know, right! Why else would I recommend her to you?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, I heard that! So you lot were doubting me just now?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Erk!

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: No, no, we weren't! You Glasgow Gang people are all incredible examples!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You're calling us... 'examples'?

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: Of course I am! Everyone knows how amazingly strong each of you are, and I hear you're a knight too... a 'Tower Knight', was that right?

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: Not to mention Instructor Indra! Joining up with a street gang's always been a childhood fantasy of mine!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I can imagine the look on my dad's face...

steps.name: Intern Operator
steps.text: I seriously can't thank you two enough, I've taken so many notes! Instructor Indra, I'll be even more powered up by the time you're back again!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: ...Pff.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What are you gigglin' for? About time someone sings my bloody praises, right?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Yeah, you are right tough!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: So, let's get back to it?
Master Finn,
As mentioned in my previous memorandum, I boarded a landship by the name of Rhodes Island, together with Siege. Today we depart it, and return to Londinium.
Indra asked I hold her final class together with her, and bid farewell to her sparring partners. It was a deliberate move of her so that I'd shake some of my nerves, I know.
I taught them how the Knights fight. I never imagined anyone would care what combat lessons a 'Knight of the Tower' had to teach.
They all know Victoria has its Steam Knights, those tremendous heroes that soar through the air, rumble-ye-rumble. People seem more keen to believe their stories.

But these operators, sparring for practice? The name of 'Tower Knights' is familiar to them too, and their notes hold our combat characteristics as you first taught me. All while they're not even Victorians.
I seem to understand why Indra loves boxing with them so much now.
I apologize, Master.

It's been so long that I'm bound to forget some of what you first taught me. But I still remember how you entrusted me with the matter of the vacant throne, though I can't remember the words in concrete any longer.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Found ya, you sneaky bastard! That should be our last drop of the good stuff!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: A shot for each! Here's to us, together once again!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We need a better celebration than this—

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Bleaagh! What IS this?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: My giddy aunt, why've we still got this blanket?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: It's been hard getting new supplies in these past few years. It's still usable if you care.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm supposing Hannah still doesn't admit she caused the gashes in it?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Wasn't me! Like I'd even bleeding remember!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Shh, keep it down! We'll have another scene if that little arsehole out there hears you!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What, scared he can take me? Back when we moved this gym sofa in, he was still in nappies!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Hannah, calm down. I can go talk to him. Too many people we've been unable to save in recent times, that's all, it's getting to him...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who gives a shit about him, let's drink! C'mere, don't just stand around like an idiot! Haven't introduced you yet, even—here, this is Baird, here, this is Dagda!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: How do you do, Madam Baird. I've heard plenty about you before. They say you do very pretty work with butterfly knives, and you make good drinks too.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Here we go again... bleeding 'Madam'...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Er, I suppose...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Shame I can't make you lot anything right now. Too low on goods, and everything we've scavenged is filthy.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: That is a shame... Indra's eyes light up every time she recalls it. I've always wanted to...

spans.text: a shame... Indra's eyes light up every time she recalls it. I've always wanted to...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Okay, okay! Nice to meet each other, ain't it? You're not getting her drinks, nah? So let's just down this stuff!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I'll fetch you a glass, Dagda. How much can you take?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Just a little'll be fine. I don't really want to get drunk.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Baird, how tough's your liver these days? Used to be we could each drink half a crate by ourselves, remember!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I'll take just a little too. I don't really drink much as of late.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Baird, want to take a walk with me?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'd like to see what this place has become. I've been away so long.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: ...Sure.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You could drink first and then go—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Agh! Bloody hell are you hittin' me for?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Let them go!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Dagda, you want a little something to drink?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: In a bit, maybe. How about after the two of them come back? Madam Baird doesn't look in the best of moods.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We haven't met for too long, is the thing. With how much's happened here...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I fancy we just need more time to chew the fat, but... that's not time we've got right now.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Forget all that nonsense! Once Baird's back, you watch me give her a right proper hug!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I've heard no end about your boxing gym. Now I'm finally seeing it... I remember the huge row I had with you all back at first. And still, after that, you gave me these clothes of mine.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Since that day, I've reckoned you to be a bunch of... pretty alright people. Just a bit tempersome.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Repeat that?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: And it's been a long time, since I've... celebrated, with a group of people like this.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Is this how you and your Masters used to do dos? Drinking and all? Or was it karaoke? Maybe a little dance?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Well, drinking was a little...! I suppose they did have to tell me to loosen up all the time, but... we did mainly sing to celebrate.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What kinda stuff?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Oooh! Alright, ahem... Isa, you're in charge of this get-together from hereon. Lead us all in celebration!

spans.text: you're in charge of this get-together from hereon. Lead us all in celebration!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha, good impression, right?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're back. What have you been talking about?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We've...
Dagda remembers the final night she sang with her colleagues in merriment.
Her Masters nudged her to allow some air between her and the Knights' creeds, and they shed their armor, and led her on down to a cramped little basement bar.

They squeezed together on the seats and held each other shoulder by shoulder, so as not to be seen, and sang to the murky ceiling at the top of their voices, singing until the patrons all about them cursed at them for the noise—
By wild and a-yonder, by rage and a-galewards ♪
Red-ripper moons and the blackest of broadswords ♪
Death hangs above in the air and does eye me ♪
Here in the tower, Victoria be me ♪

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Death hangs above in the air and does eye me ♪

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Here in the tower, Victoria be me ♪

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Death hangs above in the air and does eye me ♪

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Death hangs above in the air and does eye me ♪

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: *hic*!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: ...Baird?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You don't have to come out if you don't feel like it, I just wanted to chat with you. Things like, um. 'Siege and the gang mention you a lot, so even though this is the first we've met, I feel like I already know you pretty well.'

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: And, um... 'You speak about things a little differently to how they do, and I'd like to get to know you a little more.'

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: *cough*... Okay! I admit, Morgan pushed me to see you, I don't actually... really know what to say. I'm sorry, Madam Baird.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: ...Pfft.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Sorry, I guess my mood's been spoiling it for you lot.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You say that... The first time I met them, we ended up in a huge scrap. Indra was in splints for weeks after. I think that would've spoiled their moods more, right?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Oh, never knew about that... What did you say to set all that off?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Well, that I was a Knight of the Tower. And I'd sworn to succeed to the honor and the shame of Victoria, and I'd be leaving with Siege, so we could return to have her installed as monarch as soon as possible.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: That was the sticking point. Even on the way here, Indra hasn't stopped arguing with me about that.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: How about you lot? Did you tend to argue at first?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Mm... we'd get Hannah to clean the room for once, and she'd just stuff away everything she didn't recognize into one tiny cupboard...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Eugh, I just knew she'd do something like that...

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Or... let me think. Hannah might've accidentally sprayed Vina in the face with fizzy pop one time? I remember they had a MASSIVE scuffle about that.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Morgan was pissed afterwards. Went up to me and asked, 'how come I go in to mediate and they sock ME?'

spans.text: afterwards. Went up to me and asked, 'how come I go in to mediate and they sock ME?'

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Hahaha, that's the first I've heard of anything like that...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What about you, then? Did you ever have rows with them?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Never. I've... never fought with them before.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: In that case, I think maybe you could try having a quarrel? Er, not that I know anything, but...

spans.text: In that case, I think maybe you could
having a quarrel? Er, not that I know anything, but...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: After we first fought, Morgan gave me this outfit, and these earrings, and I was let into the Glasgow Gang. Indra started getting dead upset at all my 'knightly habits' after that, so I changed bit by bit...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: In my mind, I'm a Knight of the Tower, one to Her Majesty, King of the Siege, but at the same time, we're Glasgow Gangers too. Just friends. Don't you think?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Ugh, Morgan couldn't give me a trickier mission... How am I supposed to be the comforting sort?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: ...Pfft.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I know what you're trying to get at. We just... me and them have been apart for too long.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What's to fear? Honestly, I bet Indra reckons everything's as usual as it could be. You're still just the same in her eyes.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: That much I believe. That much, I do.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: So, may as well scrap with her first! Right?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: ...Suppose so.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Feeling better now? Wow, I'm not even sure what I'm saying anymore... See you tomorrow, then?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Right on. See you tomorrow!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Tomorrow... We've still got plenty that needs doing. It's down to us to distribute all the meds and supplies those people with you brought...
Baird pats her on the shoulders, cracks a faint little smile, and quietly hums through the tune Dagda sang when she first came back with the gang.
It stirs a memory in Dagda, of years and years ago. As if Master Finn had clapped her just as firmly on the shoulders, that final time they belted out their song.
Or perhaps, it was that encirclement, the last breakthrough, when his great bloodied hand gripped her shoulder as tightly as death.
'Isa! You... You brought us hope!'
'But you have to remember, the vacant throne...'
It's as if all this time an arrow has remained in flight, and here and now pierces true through her heart. At long last, she recalls the words that follow.
'It rests barren! Your duty is far more than to await a monarch!'

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The throne has been a barren one...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: That's what he meant by 'vacant throne' all along...
His old and weary smiles. His each and every turn to her gaze. His final breaths. His lone dying request. He hoped to push her, to free her from this gravest burden.
Dagda places her hand across the 'Book of the Tower Knights' forever on her person. A sturdy tome, a weighty one.
She continues to write no longer. In its stead, she forges one step forward, and that is all.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, I... I've got some water. Have a drink.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The Duke of Windermere's got supplies enough on this ship. You can drink what you'd like. No need to save any.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's fine. I'm much better now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How are you? And the others who boarded with us, are they...?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The soldiers lost their fellow men, and we've...
Dagda strokes lightly across her brows. Where originally they were neatly kept, new hairs are now growing out, a slight stubble against her fingers.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I can't quite remember properly. Why did Baird split up with us, back then?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Because one more time, she just wanted to get word to McClaren.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: She wanted everyone to come with. That's why she stayed behind. To fetch the bloke she knew from the video shop.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Her memory was never even that good.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I remember you all talking about how she got all careless once and let a basket of eggs slip. No breakfast for any of you the next morning.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: But she remembered how I stamp my feet about when I'm nervous. No one else even noticed, but she came over to me. Comforted me.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Why's her memory so good one moment and so bad the next...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...I should have gone with her...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Maybe I should've persuaded her just a little harder. I knew how she'd stayed there all this time. I knew she'd care for the people more than we could know...

spans.text: Maybe I should've persuaded her just a little harder. I knew how she'd stayed there all this time. I knew she'd care for the people more than we

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: But we did nothing. You did nothing.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, how much longer will you keep hesitating? When are you finally going to think to make a choice?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You have to choose!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What IS your path in the end? Are you here as revenge for your friends, to be a king, to be a leader, or is it to see your moral code through? You can't just stay the way you are, not doing anything!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You put a decision to me on the way here. You said you weren't the lord I was born to serve. Well, I've made my decision.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: May the Knight die as vassal to her king. May the Knight die for her friends.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The Knight will abide by virtue, and the Knight will gladly sacrifice. That is my oath.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But, Dagda... It doesn't feel to me like they need an Aslan King anymore. All of that's in the past.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'll stand with you, with them, and with the people aboard this ship. That's all.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, this Book of the Tower Knights is yours now. You must keep it safe and sound. That's my choice.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What are you...?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I've realized what Master Finn was trying to tell me, and what it meant for them to stake their lives in order to rescue me.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They didn't want for me to inherit their burden. They entrusted a 'vacant throne' to me, so I wouldn't deceive myself with the weight of it all like they did... They wanted me to see Victoria's future in their place, with clear eyes.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I give this book to you. No longer am I just Isabelle Montague, Knight of the Tower. Now more than ever, I'm Dagda of the Glasgow Gang.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm not protecting Victoria's king, no. I'm just protecting my friend.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Alright.
The wind flies past their faces, endlessly for the yonder behind them, as if it blows everything away.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Once the war's over, I'll take you to visit the tower. Visit my masters.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Never since I swore my oath have the lights in the Palace been lit, out behind the Tower. I've never guarded a Victorian monarch. We Knights of the Tower... long lost everything we ever protected.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: So I have to ask. Have the Knights of the Tower accomplished their duty...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Your duty is accomplished.
